Beside steel products; projects with various super alloys, titanium alloys, cobalt alloys etc are being realized. From automobile development to smart factories, our Swiss-designed sensor solutions are driving the future of electrified drive technology, industrial automation, and emission reduction ## Purpose of the position # Purpose of the Position # The Sales and Application Engineer is responsible for achieving sales goals for Kistler’s Traffic Solutions group. This role oversees sales performance, business development, and technical support for the Traffic Solutions group across North America. ## Your typical day # Main Tasks * Achieve sales targets and drive the growth of Kistler’s Traffic and Infrastructure group by providing Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) products and services across North America * Manage and support system integrator accounts, Department of Transportation (DOT) customers, partners, and other key stakeholders. * Provide technical and sales support through customer visits, web meetings, phone, and email, including technical quotes and commercial proposals. * Develop new projects, business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and customer relationships to expand market presence and drive sales. * Maintain strong knowledge of market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity; provide insights to support sales and marketing strategies. * Share technical knowledge and best practices with internal teams and collaborate with sales and application specialists across the Americas and globally. * Manage territory activity and sales opportunities through the company CRM system to ensure accurate tracking, reporting, and follow-up. * Execute sales and business strategies in alignment with annual targets and objectives. * Support marketing initiatives, including trade shows, seminars, customer events, and promotional activities. * Collaborate with Marketing and internal teams to develop content and materials that promote Kistler Traffic Solutions and its products to customers, partners, and employees. ## Your profile # Requirements Profile * Bachelor’s degree in business and or Engineering preferred * Minimum of 5+ years  experience in B2G sales of capital equipment in traffic sector (ANPR/LPR cameras, Weigh-in-Motion (WIM) Systems, Roadside Units (RSU), or related ITS equipment) * Minimum of 5 years’ experience in sales management, project management or large accounts management * Experience in the application of sensors, electronics and devices for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) applications * Knowledge of network communications equipment, devices and protocols * Knowledge of systems engineering and integration * Preferred experience with weigh-in-motion (WIM) and/or structural health monitoring (SHM) is a plus * Strong organizational skills and systematic approach * Physical requirements: ability to lift -50 pounds unassisted. * Ability to travel (>50%) in United States and Canada and occasional international travel as required. ## What you can expect from us **Why Kistler?** At Kistler, we value your expertise and offer opportunities for professional growth in a global environment. Our competitive benefits package includes: * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage * 401(k) plan with a 4% company match * Generous personal and vacation time Join a team that’s shaping the future of measurement technology. We look forward to meeting you! Kistler Instrument Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Working mode Full Remote Travelling 50 Place of work Novi, US Salary 97000 $
